questions.prompt: What does a line graph show best?
questions.explanation: A line graph follows one value as time passes. Favourite colours are groups, so a bar chart is better for them.

questions.prompt: On a line graph, the line goes down from Monday to Tuesday. What does that mean?
questions.explanation: A line going down means the value is falling. A flat line would mean nothing changed.

questions.prompt: The temperature was 16°C at 8 am, 20°C at 10 am, 25°C at 12 noon, 27°C at 2 pm and 23°C at 4 pm. When was it hottest?
questions.explanation: The highest value is 27°C, at 2 pm. It was still rising at 12 noon.

questions.prompt: The temperature was 16°C at 8 am, 20°C at 10 am, 25°C at 12 noon, 27°C at 2 pm and 23°C at 4 pm. How much did the temperature rise between 8 am and 12 noon?
questions.explanation: Subtract: 25 - 16 = 9. Adding the two gives 41, and 4 is only the rise from 8 am to 10 am.

questions.prompt: The temperature was 16°C at 8 am, 20°C at 10 am, 25°C at 12 noon, 27°C at 2 pm and 23°C at 4 pm. Between which times did the temperature fall?
questions.explanation: It went from 27°C down to 23°C between 2 pm and 4 pm. Before that it was rising each time.

questions.prompt: A maize plant is 10 cm tall in week 1 and 30 cm tall in week 4. How much did it grow?
questions.explanation: Growth is the difference: 30 - 10 = 20 cm. Adding the two heights gives 40, which is not the growth.
